admin/settings/copy-setting-to-locations.test_name: Admin can copy an individual checkout setting to another location in the chain

attempts.hypothesis: PublishToLocationsModalComponent.deselectAll() reads the Select All/Deselect All toggle text before the modal's chain-location list finishes loading and auto-selecting everything, so the read can land on the pre-load state and skip its click.
attempts.fix_applied: deselectAll() now waits for the toggle to settle into its guaranteed post-load 'Deselect All' state before reading/clicking it.
attempts.result: red-green-revert-restore proven; 20/20 Vape isolation; load-realistic 3/3 (workers=6, dutchie-e2e constellation)
